text: [[col:yellow]]Population is falling[[/col]]\\nAt least one settlement in this commandery is losing population this turn. Settlements that run dry cannot recruit or grow, and the population effect bundle they carry will drop a tier.

[[col:red]]Population is collapsing[[/col]]\\nAt least one settlement in this commandery has run out of population, or is on the lowest population tier and still falling. Recruitment and growth stop entirely at zero.

[[col:yellow]]Faction support is low[[/col]]\\nAt least one settlement in this commandery is below full faction support. Until it reaches 80%, its support tier applies penalties to income, public order and military supplies.

[[col:red]]Faction support is critical[[/col]]\\nAt least one settlement in this commandery is below 40% faction support. At this tier the penalties are severe - a quarter or more of the regions gross income, and a heavy public order drag.
